      - participant-key-state:/var/lib/vita-fl
    tmpfs:

      NODE_ENV: production
      IPFS_PROVIDER: kubo

      ACCOUNT_ADDRESS: "0x15d34AAf54267DB7D7c367839AAf71A00a2C6A65"
      DEVICE_ID: "4"
